-- On-time rate by lane, last 30 days
SELECT l.code AS lane,
       count(*) AS shipments,
       avg((s.delivered_at <= s.promised_at)::int) AS on_time
FROM   shipments s
JOIN   lanes l ON l.id = s.lane_id
WHERE  s.picked_up_at >= now() - interval '30 days'
GROUP BY l.code
ORDER BY on_time DESC;
